_provenance.upstream_operation: ECDSA sigVer FIPS186-5 AFT (dedicated SigVer vectors with upstream testPassed + reason)
_provenance.local_operation: C_CreateObject(CKO_PUBLIC_KEY, CKK_EC, CKA_EC_PARAMS = curve OID, CKA_EC_POINT = DER(04||qx||qy)) then C_VerifyInit(CKM_ECDSA_<hash>) + C_Verify(message, r||s); CKR_OK required for testPassed=true; for testPassed=false the key import, C_VerifyInit or C_Verify must refuse (CKR_SIGNATURE_INVALID expected at C_Verify for modified message/r/s)
_provenance.transformation: subset only; every retained field is byte-copied from the upstream file (hex case preserved); no value is re-derived
_provenance.subset_policy: Deterministic. Every case (1 valid + 6 invalid reasons: modify message, modify key, modify r, modify s, zero r, zero s) of every group whose hashAlg has a PKCS#11 v3.2 CKM_ECDSA_<hash> mechanism both engines advertise (SHA2-256, SHA2-512, SHA3-256, SHA3-512), on all four upstream curves (P-224, P-256, P-384, P-521). Groups hashing with SHA2-512/256, SHAKE-128 or SHAKE-256 are listed in notExecuted: PKCS#11 v3.2 defines no CKM_ECDSA_<hash> mechanism for them.
_provenance.retained_fields: tcId, testPassed, reason, message, qx, qy, r, s (d dropped)
